title: "Blue Hour" - Arcade Female Boxing ala "Punch Out"
author: mykedo
selftext:
I wanted to show a glimpse of an arcade punch-out like im working on.  Its still WIP, the target is to have \~8 to 10 unique enemies with Backstory, Training mode, Story Mode.

There will be a lot of strong females with each having a own strategy and telling singns for blocks and evasion. Mechanics are not yet final, as im still working on the roster.

There is as well additional potential for Animation work. But i wanted to keep it "Arcadey". 

Check until the end...im still wondering if the finisher shall be less impactfull.

You play as Cat, an upcomming female boxer who tries to reach the top in the oninous "Blue Hour" gym / competition.

It will be quiet niche, but i would love your honest feedback, and if you would play it?
